CustomField.label: Support Tier
CustomField.description: Derived support tier based on commercial signals. Used for routing support calls (via IVR HTTP callout to middleware) and tickets (via Case Before-Save Flow). Priority order: HYPERCARE > STRATEGIC > PREMIUM > STANDARD. See docs/revenue-in-support/01-field-definitions-and-phone-audit.md
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Customer tier used for support routing: HYPERCARE (active hypercare), STRATEGIC (top customer or SAAS premium), PREMIUM (SAAS enterprise + GREEN/AMBER), STANDARD (everything else). Derived automatically.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(TEXT(Hypercare_active__c) = "Active", OR(ISBLANK(Hypercare_End_Date__c), Hypercare_End_Date__c >= NOW())), "HYPERCARE", IF( OR(Top_Customer__c = TRUE, Is_SAAS_Premium_Account__c = TRUE), "STRATEGIC", IF( AND(SAAS_Enterprise_Account__c = TRUE, OR(TEXT(RAG__c) = "GREEN", TEXT(RAG__c) = "AMBER")), "PREMIUM", "STANDARD" ) ) )
